name: Grievance Officer
description: L1, L2 or L3 officer. Desks come from the grievance-placement attributes.

name: Grievance Desk Head
description: Grant together with grievance_level L3; oan_auth_service removes roles Keycloak does not grant.

name: Grievance Review Officer
description: Read-only reviewer on the categories in grievance_categories.

name: Grievance Dashboard Reader
description: Read access to the grievance dashboards.

name: Grievance Admin
description: Grievance platform administrator. Not bound to any desk.
